mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY SET STATUS = 'ERROR' WHERE STATUS IN ('READY', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY SET DS_ID = #{dsId}, SCHEMA_NM = #{schemaNm}, PREV_COLLECT_DT = TO_TIMESTAMP(#{prevCollectDt}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), TOTAL_TABLES = #{totalTables}, TOTAL_COLUMNS = #{totalColumns}, ADDED_TABLES = #{addedTables}, ADDED_COLUMNS = #{addedColumns}, MODIFIED_COLUMNS = #{modifiedColumns}, DELETED_TABLES = #{deletedTables}, DELETED_COLUMNS = #{deletedColumns}, TOTAL_INDEXES = #{totalIndexes}, ADDED_INDEXES = #{addedIndexes}, MODIFIED_INDEXES = #{modifiedIndexes}, DELETED_INDEXES = #{deletedIndexes}, TOTAL_CONSTRAINTS = #{totalConstraints}, ADDED_CONSTRAINTS = #{addedConstraints}, MODIFIED_CONSTRAINTS = #{modifiedConstraints}, DELETED_CONSTRAINTS = #{deletedConstraints} WHERE DIAG_ID = #{diagId}
UPDATE TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE DIAG_ID = #{diagId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STRUCT_DIAG_DETAIL ( DIAG_ID, SEQ, OWNER, TABLE_NM, COLUMN_NM, CHANGE_TYPE, PREV_DATA_TYPE, CURR_DATA_TYPE, PREV_DATA_LEN, CURR_DATA_LEN, PREV_NULLABLE, CURR_NULLABLE, CURR_ATTR_NM_KR, CURR_DATA_DECIMAL_LEN, CURR_PK_YN, CURR_DEFAULT_VAL, CURR_ATTR_ORD ) VALUES ( #{diagId}, #{seq}, #{owner}, #{tableNm}, #{columnNm}, #{changeType}, #{prevDataType}, #{currDataType}, #{prevDataLen}, #{currDataLen}, #{prevNullable}, #{currNullable}, #{currAttrNmKr, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currDataDecimalLen, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{currPkYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{currDefaultVal, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currAttrOrd, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND OBJ_OWNER = #{objOwner} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT DIAG_ID FROM TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY WHERE DATA_MODEL_ID = #{dataModelId} AND STATUS = 'DONE' ORDER BY DIAG_DT DESC, DIAG_ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT UPPER(COALESCE(A.OBJ_OWNER, '')) AS "owner", A.OBJ_NM AS "tableNm", A.ATTR_NM AS "columnNm", A.DATA_TYPE AS "dataType", A.DATA_LEN AS "dataLen", A.NULLABLE_YN AS "nullableYn" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O ON O.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND COALESCE(O.OBJ_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(A.OBJ_OWNER, '') AND O.OBJ_NM = A.OBJ_NM WHERE A.DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND O.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT h.DIAG_ID, h.DS_ID, h.DATA_MODEL_ID, h.SCHEMA_NM, to_char(h.DIAG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DIAG_DT, to_char(h.PREV_COLLECT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PREV_COLLECT_DT, h.TOTAL_TABLES, h.TOTAL_COLUMNS, h.ADDED_TABLES, h.ADDED_COLUMNS, h.MODIFIED_COLUMNS, h.DELETED_TABLES, h.DELETED_COLUMNS, h.TOTAL_INDEXES, h.ADDED_INDEXES, h.MODIFIED_INDEXES, h.DELETED_INDEXES, h.TOTAL_CONSTRAINTS, h.ADDED_CONSTRAINTS, h.MODIFIED_CONSTRAINTS, h.DELETED_CONSTRAINTS, h.STATUS, h.CRET_USER_ID, dm.DM_NM AS DATA_MODEL_NM FROM TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY h LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL dm ON dm.DM_ID = h.DATA_MODEL_ID ORDER BY h.DIAG_DT DESC

SELECT DIAG_ID, SEQ, OWNER, TABLE_NM, COLUMN_NM, CHANGE_TYPE, PREV_DATA_TYPE, CURR_DATA_TYPE, PREV_DATA_LEN, CURR_DATA_LEN, PREV_NULLABLE, CURR_NULLABLE, CURR_ATTR_NM_KR, CURR_DATA_DECIMAL_LEN, CURR_PK_YN, CURR_DEFAULT_VAL, CURR_ATTR_ORD, APPLIED_DT, APPLIED_USER_ID FROM TB_STRUCT_DIAG_DETAIL WHERE DIAG_ID = #{diagId} ORDER BY TABLE_NM, SEQ

SELECT h.DIAG_ID, h.DS_ID, h.DATA_MODEL_ID, h.SCHEMA_NM, to_char(h.DIAG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DIAG_DT, to_char(h.PREV_COLLECT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PREV_COLLECT_DT, h.TOTAL_TABLES, h.TOTAL_COLUMNS, h.ADDED_TABLES, h.ADDED_COLUMNS, h.MODIFIED_COLUMNS, h.DELETED_TABLES, h.DELETED_COLUMNS, h.TOTAL_INDEXES, h.ADDED_INDEXES, h.MODIFIED_INDEXES, h.DELETED_INDEXES, h.TOTAL_CONSTRAINTS, h.ADDED_CONSTRAINTS, h.MODIFIED_CONSTRAINTS, h.DELETED_CONSTRAINTS, h.STATUS, h.CRET_USER_ID, dm.DM_NM AS DATA_MODEL_NM FROM TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY h LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL dm ON dm.DM_ID = h.DATA_MODEL_ID WHERE h.DIAG_ID = #{diagId}

SELECT h.DIAG_ID, h.DS_ID, h.DATA_MODEL_ID, h.SCHEMA_NM, to_char(h.DIAG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DIAG_DT, to_char(h.PREV_COLLECT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PREV_COLLECT_DT, h.TOTAL_TABLES, h.TOTAL_COLUMNS, h.ADDED_TABLES, h.ADDED_COLUMNS, h.MODIFIED_COLUMNS, h.DELETED_TABLES, h.DELETED_COLUMNS, h.TOTAL_INDEXES, h.ADDED_INDEXES, h.MODIFIED_INDEXES, h.DELETED_INDEXES, h.TOTAL_CONSTRAINTS, h.ADDED_CONSTRAINTS, h.MODIFIED_CONSTRAINTS, h.DELETED_CONSTRAINTS, h.STATUS, h.CRET_USER_ID, dm.DM_NM AS DATA_MODEL_NM FROM TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY h LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL dm ON dm.DM_ID = h.DATA_MODEL_ID WHERE h.DATA_MODEL_ID = #{dataModelId} AND h.STATUS = 'DONE' ORDER BY h.DIAG_DT DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DATA_MODEL SET STRUCT_DIAG_YN = #{structDiagYn}, STRUCT_DIAG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STRUCT_DIAG_CONSTRAINT_DETAIL ( DIAG_ID, SEQ, OWNER, TABLE_NM, CONSTRAINT_NM, CHANGE_TYPE, PREV_CONSTRAINT_TYPE, CURR_CONSTRAINT_TYPE, PREV_COLUMNS, CURR_COLUMNS, PREV_REF_TABLE, CURR_REF_TABLE, PREV_REF_COLUMNS, CURR_REF_COLUMNS, PREV_DELETE_RULE, CURR_DELETE_RULE, PREV_STATUS, CURR_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{diagId}, #{seq}, #{owner}, #{tableNm}, #{constraintNm}, #{changeType}, #{prevConstraintType}, #{currConstraintType}, #{prevColumns}, #{currColumns}, #{prevRefTable}, #{currRefTable}, #{prevRefColumns}, #{currRefColumns}, #{prevDeleteRule}, #{currDeleteRule}, #{prevStatus}, #{currStatus} )
